row.text:
Mia was having a nice dream. She was flying like she was a butterfly. Suddenly the alarm rang. Mia woke up with a start. She remembered that today was an important day. It was the day of the big race. Mia had been practising for weeks and she was excited and a little scared.

Mia put on her running shoes and ran to the park. When she got there, Mia saw all of her friends and they started running together. Mia ran as fast as she could and soon she was crossing the finish line first.

The crowd cheered loudly and Mia was given the trophy. She held it in her hands and it glittered and shone in the sun. Mia was so happy.

"Well done Mia," said Mum. "You should be proud of yourself. You worked so hard to win this trophy".

Mia smiled and hugged her Mum tightly. She felt so brave and strong. Mia knew that nothing was too scary for her.

Once upon a time there was a bunny named Binky. Binky wanted to build something special. He hopped to the store and saw a nice microphone. He wanted it for his house.

Binky asked the shopkeeper, "Can I build this with my hands?"

The shopkeeper smiled, "Of course you can. You need blocks and tools."

Binky hopped home and started to build. He put the blocks together and was really proud. He was finished! 

The microphone was shiny and perfect. Binky was so excited, he wanted to get something tasty to celebrate. He hopped to the bakery and bought some cookies. They were so yummy and sweet!

Binky decided to take a break and try out the microphone. He talked into it and heard his own voice, loud and clear! He was so happy.

Binky was so proud of his microphone. He had a tasty snack and was pleased with his work. Binky hopped home, ready for his next adventure.

Once upon a time, two good friends named Jack and Jill lived together. They liked to do lots of fun things together. One day, they went to the park together.

At the park, they saw lots of people playing a game. It looked like lots of fun so Jack and Jill asked them what they were playing. The people told them it was called tag. Jack asked, "Can we play too?" The people said yes, so Jack and Jill started playing tag.

At first, Jack was very good at the game and he would tag Jill every day. Jill was beginning to feel a bit jealous. She said to Jack, "Why do you always tag me?" Jack replied, "Because you're the fastest one here so it's easy for me to catch you. That's why I tag you." Jill smiled.

Everyday, Jack and Jill would play tag and Jack would repeatly tag Jill. Jack and Jill were having lots of fun together and also became best friends. They played tag every day until they grew old.

Once upon a time, there was a gifted little girl. Every day, she rose early and went to the fields to help harvest wheat. Her friends came along to help her, and they all had a lot of fun.

One day, when they were done gathering the wheat, the little girl called out to her friends, "Let's make a big tower out of the wheat!" Everyone cheered and said it was a great idea.

So they all worked together to build the tower. They rose one wheat stalk at a time until it was as tall as they were! They were so proud of their tower and they all cheered when it was done.

The little girl then smiled and said, "Together, we really can do anything!" Her friends agreed, and they laughed as they ran off to play.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jack and Jane. They were playing together in the park with their wagon. Jack wanted to pull the wagon and was so excited to play. Jane was happy too, but she said "Wait a minute! Let's delay, we should get a sparkly toy first!"

So, they went to the popular store. When they arrived, the store was full of different kinds of toys. It was so hard for them to choose just one - all the toys looked exciting! But finally, Jack chose a fire truck with red and blue colors. Jane was so excited and said "Can I play with it too?" Jack said "Yes!"

After they bought the toy, they went back to the park with the wagon. They had so much fun playing together. They even got to give their wagon a ride too.

The end!

Peter and Mommy were walking in the park. Peter was very excited because he wanted to see all the bugs. He bent down to get a better look, and his mommy laughed. â€œOh Peter, youâ€™re embarrassing me!â€ she said. 

But Peter wasnâ€™t embarrassed. He was happy. He saw lots of colorful bugs crawling in the grass. â€œMommy, can I pick them up?â€ he asked, pointing at the bugs. 

â€œNo, maybe we should just watch them!â€ Mommy said. â€œItâ€™s not safe for you to touch them. But you can look with your eyes.â€

Peter was happy with that. He looked at the bugs and asked Mommy lots of questions. After a while, he said he was ready to go home. Mommy and Peter said goodbye to the bugs, and they walked back home. It was a very fun, safe day!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Margaret. Margaret wanted to go to the park to play, but her mother said she had to stay home. Margaret was sad, so she looked for something to do.

Suddenly, Margaret saw a trap on the ground. It looked like a box with a hole in the top. Margaret didn't know what the trap was.

"Mommy," she asked. "What is this?"

"It's a harmless animal trap," explained her mom. "It's a way to introduce animals we can study and learn about."

That sounded exciting! Margaret decided to try her own animal trap. She got a box and placed it outside, putting some food inside.

Sure enough, an animal came to the trap looking for food. Margaret was so excited! She looked closely and saw that it was a cute little mouse.

Margaret felt happy. She had introduced something new to the world â€“ and it was harmless!

Jack was a sleepy little boy. He yawned and stretched, ready for a nap.
Jack's mom called him to the living room. He saw a tall man wearing a funny hat.
"This is the doctor," said Mom.
Jack frowned. He didn't like doctors.
"Don't be scared," said the doctor with a fake smile. "I'm here to help you take a nap."
Jack relaxed a little. The doctor gave him a special medicine that tasted bubbly and sweet. Then Jack lay down and closed his eyes.

When he woke up, he felt happy and refreshed. The doctor had helped him take a good nap. From now on, Jack was never scared of the doctor again.

Once upon a time, there was a young bear called Beartie. Beartie had been invited to a party, but he was feeling very sad and he forgot to get ready. Suddenly, his grandmother came in. She was so wise and she had a plan to make Beartie feel better.

Grandma smiled and said: "Letâ€™s get you all clean and ready for the party. You look very nice in your clean clothes.â€ 

Beartie smiled and hugged his grandma. He felt much better now that they had a plan. Together they got Beartie dressed in a brand new outfit. 

Beartie felt so excited, but then he remembered something else. He felt sad again. 

Grandma smiled and said: â€œDonâ€™t worry. I will remind you to bring a special gift for the party. I know you will find the perfect one.â€ 

Beartie smiled and hugged his grandma again. He felt much better now and went off to the party with a happy heart.

Mommy and Daddy were preparing dinner. Mommy was taking out pieces of chicken from the fridge while Daddy loaded the oven with vegetables.

Mommy said to Daddy, "Are you sure we have enough vegetables?"

Daddy nodded his head. "Yep, I loaded lots of carrots, potatoes, and corn in the oven."

Mommy smiled. "Very good! Don't forget to spread them out in a thick layer so they cook all the way through."

Daddy smiled back. "Don't worry, Mommy, I know what to do. I'm making sure they cook nice and thick so you can enjoy the yummy vegetables!"

Mommy nodded her head. "That's right. Soon enough, we'll all be eating our delicious dinner!"

Once there was a friendly cat who liked to balance on a fence. In the morning, he would jump up and meow to greet the sun.

One day, a little girl named Suzy walked by the fence. As she looked at the cat, he blinked his eyes and meowed hello.

"What a nice cat!" Suzy said.

"Meow!" said the cat.

Suzy sat down by the fence and the friendly cat jumped down and came closer. She petted him and the cat purred with joy. They sat together for a while, the cat balancing on the fence and Suzy playing with him.

It was a nice day, and Suzy and the cat had lots of fun together. They were the best of friends, and they would meet every day to play and balance together.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl. She was so excited because it was a sunny day. She raced outside to play in the sun. 

The little girl saw the ice on the ground. She touched it and noticed how cold and slippery it was. She wanted to have fun with it so she decided to slide.

She said to herself, "I must be careful, I don't want to fall down." The sun shone brightly in the sky and it was so warm and inviting. 

She planted her feet firmly on the ground and pushed off. She slid on the ice and laughed with joy. She felt so happy. Her mom came out from the house and said, "Be careful my darling, you don't want to get hurt!" 

The little girl smiled and said, "I am careful, look how much fun I'm having!" Then she kept on playing in the sun and sliding on the ice as the sun shone brighter and brighter.

Once upon a time there was a very special player. He was gifted and could do so many amazing things with a ball. Every day he would go outside and practice catching and throwing. He was the best player in the neighbourhood. 

One day, the player was throwing a ball against a wall when suddenly he heard a loud yell! He jumped back and saw a little girl with her hands on her hips. 

"That's my ball!" she yelled.

The player smiled and said, "Would you like to play catch with me?"

The little girl smiled, said yes and the two of them had a great time playing together for the rest of the afternoon.

Once upon a time there was a factory that made fake toys. The toys looked real, but they were not. One day a little girl named Jacky came to the factory. She saw a big box that was rolling around. Jacky opened the box, and there was an old rusty toy car inside! 

Jacky picked up the car with a big smile and said, "Cool!" She pushed the car around the factory, then decided to take it home.

On the way home, one of the tires of the car fell off. Jacky looked sad, and so she stopped at a store to buy another tire. She looked at all the tires, but none of them fit her toy car. 

But then, Jacky saw a tire that was shaped like a bubble! She asked the shopkeeper, "Is this tire real?" 

The shopkeeper smiled and said, "No, it's just a fake tire. But it will fit perfectly on your toy car! Take it home and have fun rolling around the house!" 

Jacky was so happy. She thanked the shopkeeper and took the fake tire home. She quickly put it on her toy car, and off she went rolling around the house!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Sue. Sue was a very curious little girl. She liked to explore and do new things.

One day, Sue decided to write a story. She grabbed her favourite yellow crayon and a piece of paper. She scribbled and drew, and wrote little words. When she finished her story, it was beautiful.

But then something not-so-nice happened. Someone dropped a smelly sandwich next to Sue's story. Sue's story was now covered in smelly crumbs.

Sue was so sad. She cried and said, "Oh, no! My story is ruined!"

Just then, her neighbour, Mr. Cat, walked by. He saw Sue's sad face and said, "Don't worry Sue, we can fix this. Why don't you write another piece and this time let's make sure that it stays away from smelly sandwich crumbs!"

Sue looked up and smiled. She grabbed a pen and wrote a new story. This time, it was even better than the first. And the best part was that it was crumb-free!

Once upon a time, there was a young boy. He lived in a big house with his family. The boy was very regular and liked to play a lot.

One afternoon, he heard a knock at the door. He ran to answer it and was so excited to see who it was. He opened the door and invited the person in with a big welcome.

It was his best friend Henry. The boy and Henry said hello and hugged each other. They were so happy to see each other again.

The two boys decided to have a regular game of catch. They played for a long time and laughed until their sides hurt.

When it was time for Henry to go home, the boy gave him a big hug and welcomed him back anytime. The boy and his family waved goodbye as Henry walked home.

Once upon a time there was a brown rabbit. The rabbit was very happy and always hopping around. One day he noticed something was wrong with his foot. He couldn't hop like he used to. He hopped to the barn to ask for help.

The farmer saw the rabbit and said, "I can help you. You need to get repaired." He brought out some tools and began to repair the rabbit's foot. 

The farmer asked, "Do you feel better now?"

The rabbit hopped around, "Yes! Thank you farmer."

The farmer smiled, "You're welcome, rabbit. Now go enjoy hopping around and be careful."

The rabbit hopped away happily and enjoyed the rest of his day. He was grateful for the farmer and his repair.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emily. She was three years old, and she liked finding new things.

One day, Emily went on a walk with her mom. They were in the garden, and Mom said, "Look, Emily! What do you see?"

"I see a zipper!" said Emily excitedly. Emily was very curious about the zipper, so she decided to be polite and ask.

"Mommy, what is that?"

"It's a zipper," replied Mom.

Emily then discovered she could open the zipper. She carefully opened it and found a box inside. She was so excited to open the box!

The box was full of fun toys! Emily had a great time playing with them. She and Mom played hide and seek with the toys for the rest of the day.

At the end, Emily was happy and tired. She had a wonderful day discovering new things.

Kimmy was very embarrassed. She had fallen while running, and now she had a big stitch in her leg. She started to cry.

"Don't be sad," said her mom. She touched Kimmy's leg gently with her fingers. "It's alright. See, I can feel your stitch right here."

Kimmy sniffed and nodded. She wiped the tears off her face.

Then her mom smiled. "Your stitch doesn't have to be a bad thing," she said. "In fact, it can be something special!"

"How?" asked Kimmy.

"Let's give it a special hug," said her mom. She hugged Kimmy's leg around the stitch.

Kimmy smiled. Suddenly she didn't feel embarrassed anymore. She felt warm and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved being outdoors. She loved learning about all of the different plants and animals and especially playing in the summer sunshine.

One day, she went out for a walk and spotted a peach tree. She was so excited to see all of the peaches growing on it.

Without hesitation, she ran up to the tree and looked around. She spotted a little peach at the very top, so she decided to see if she could reach it.

She stretched her arms up, but she just couldn't get it. Feeling discouraged, she walked away.

Just then, an kind old voice spoke to the girl. "Why don't you ask the peach if you can have it?"

The little girl was surprised. She turned around to see an old lady smiling at her.

The girl thought for a minute and then asked the peach if it was ok for her to take it.

To her surprise, the peach said yes!

The little girl was so excited. She quickly plucked the peach off the tree, thanked the kind old lady, and ran home with her little peach.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old.
One day, Lucy saw a gray bird. It was hopping around in the grass. She thought the bird was so pretty.

Lucy said to the bird, "Hi! What's your name? Would you like to join me for a meal?"

The bird hopped closer to Lucy and said, "Chirp! Chirp! My name is Tweet. Yes, I would love to join you for a meal!"

So Lucy and Tweet had a meal together. They ate yummy food and drank sweet juice.  They chatted and laughed and they had so much fun.

When it was time to go, Tweet said goodbye. She said, "Chirp! Chirp! It was nice to join you for a meal, Lucy!"

Lucy smiled and waved goodbye to Tweet. She was so happy to have a new friend.

Once there was a girl called Jane. She was very polite and kind. One day, she wanted to help her Mom in the kitchen. 

She went to the cupboard and found a plate. She was so excited and carried it to the kitchen table.

Suddenly, Jane heard her Mom calling her, "Jane honey, could you be a polite girl and carry the plate to the dining room?"

Jane smiled and said, "Yes Mommy, I can do that". She neatly carried the plate to the dining room, and put it on the table.

Jane's Mom hugged her and said, "Thank you sweetheart, you are such a good girl!" Jane was so pleased and could not stop smiling.

Once there was a mountain and upon it a billboard. Each day the sun shined brightly and the trees sang. But one day, the sun became very harsh, and the billboard got bigger and bigger.

The animals were scared and ran away from it. They gathered around to figure out what to do. 

The peacock spoke first. "Let us ask the mountain," said the peacock.

The animals shouted to the mountain. They asked, "Why does the billboard increase? It's too harsh for us."

The mountain replied, "I cannot stop it. It is beyond my control." 

The animals then looked around at each other, but no one had any idea how to make the billboard reduce. So the animals kept running away from the bright and harsh billboard. 

All the animals lived in fear, until one day the sun went away and the billboard reduced back to its original size. The animals rejoiced and ran home, happy to be back in the peaceful mountain.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy bear. His name was Bob and he lived in the woods. Every week Bob did nothing all day long.

One day, Bob smelled something delicious. He followed the smell and found a campfire. He saw a hot dog and it smelled so good.

Bob got too close and his fur started to burn. He screamed and scuttled away.

The next day, Bob decided to stay away from the campfire. He thought, "It's too hot. I'm not going near it!"

But the day after that, Bob heard someone calling his name. It was his friend, Joe. 

Joe said, "Bob, why don't you join us around the campfire? It's so nice and warm! You won't get burned I promise."

Bob thought about it and decided that getting warm by the campfire would be better than being cold and lazy. He went over and stood at a safe distance and enjoyed the warm fire for the rest of the week.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was eager to eat something yummy. The girl's mom told her a story about a very special treat. It was called a cupcake and it was said to taste like the best flavor ever.

The little girl was so eager to taste the cupcake that she begged her mom to make one. So the mom went to the kitchen and started to make the cupcake. Soon the cupcake was ready and the little girl was so excited.

The little girl took a bite of the cupcake and it tasted amazing. She closed her eyes and smiled. When she opened her eyes again, she asked her mom, "Can I have more?" Her mom laughed and said, "Of course! Go have another bite." 

The little girl happily took a second bite of the cupcake and smiled. Her mom said, "I'm glad you liked the cupcake and that you enjoyed the story too!"  The little girl smiled and snuggled up close to her mom. And the two of them enjoyed the story and the sweet taste of the cupcake.

Once there was a truck. He was very grumpy because he couldn't help anyone. Every day he drove around, just looking at all the people that he wanted to help, but he couldn't.

One day he stopped at a playground and he saw a little girl having trouble. The truck tried to help out but he was too big and it made the little girl scared.

The truck was so sad he almost started to cry. Then he heard someone say, "Don't be sad truck. I can help you."

The truck looked up and saw the little girl. Even though she was very small, she was determined to help. So the truck and the little girl figured out a way for the truck to help the playground.

The truck was so happy, he even forgot how grumpy he was before. The little girl said, "See truck, you can help people if you just try." 
The truck agreed and said, "Thank you for helping me help others."

One day, Margo the bear was feeling very gloomy. She had a lot of work to do, but she couldn't find the power to start. Suddenly, she heard a voice. It was her friend Stella saying, "Let me help you Margo!"

Margo smiled and said, "Thank you Stella! What should we do first?"

Stella had a plan. "Let's clean the room!" Together, they started to clean up. Margo put away her toys and Stella wiped the windows. As they worked, Margo's gloom began to fade.

Finally, the room was clean and shiny. Stella smiled and said, "See, now the room is all nice and tidy. You should feel better now!"

Margo looked around the clean room and smiled. "Yes, I feel much better now. Thank you Stella!"

Once upon a time there was a little red bear. He was sad because his fur had become worn and faded. One day he saw a magical fairy flying nearby.

"Fairy, can you help me?" asked the bear.

The fairy smiled. "I can," she said. She waved her wand and used her magic to restore the bear's fur. Instantly, the fur was bright and shiny, turning an even brighter red.

The bear was so happy. "Thank you so much, Fairy!"

The fairy smiled and said, "You're welcome." She flew away, leaving the bear happy and restored.

The bear ran off, excited to show off his beautiful red fur to all his friends!

Once there was a little girl called Mandy. She could not wait to go out and play in the sunshine.

Mandy hugged her mum and said, "When can I go outside?"

"Wait a moment, let me measure you first," said her mum.

Mandy stood still while her mum measured the length of her legs and body.

When she was done her mum said, "You are ready now. Go and play."

Mandy ran out into the garden.

She looked around. Everywhere there were butterflies, fluttering and playing in the sunshine.

Mandy jumped on the grass. The sun made her skin feel comfortable and warm. She laughed and laughed.

Then she saw a beautiful butterfly. She followed it around the garden until it finally landed on a flower.

Mandy smiled. She felt happy and free.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Mary. Mary was very rich and very happy. She had lots of nice things, but sometimes she was sad because she was ill.

One day, Mary's mom said to her, "We need to go to the doctor and get you some medicine, Mary." Mary was scared but nodded her head. 

At the doctor's, Mary was given some medicine. She didn't like it very much because it tasted bad. But, the doctor said it was very important to take the medicine so she did. 

When she got home, Mary's mom hugged her and said, "See, dear? I told you the medicine would make you feel better." 

Mary was glad. She felt much better and she was happy again. She hugged her mom and said "Thank you for getting me the medicine. Now I'm not sick anymore!" 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Shannon. She was three years old and was always curious about the world. She was visiting her uncle and aunt's house.

One day, Shannon asked her aunt if she could go to the station. Her aunt said yes, so Shannon put on her colorful coat and cap, and went out.

When Shannon reached the station, she was very excited to see lots of colorful trains. She wanted to get on one of them and explore.

Suddenly, an announcement came over the loudspeaker: "All passengers, please put your bag on the train before boarding."

Shannon smiled, and put her bag on the train. She was delighted to be going on her first train journey.

"Where is the train taking me?" Shannon asked her aunt.

"It's your surprise, Shannon." said her aunt. "Let's find out when we arrive".

Shannon smiled, and went on an adventure.

John and Jane were best friends. They did everything together. They played in the park, they went swimming in the pool, and they even shared their lunch.

One day when John and Jane were eating lunch together, John opened his lunchbox and saw that Jane had a big slice of cake. He became very jealous.

John said to Jane, "Why do you have cake?" He sounded very sad. 

Jane said, "Don't be jealous. Listen, my mom put some salt on the cake so it tastes a bit strange. You can have a bite if you want."

John was so happy to hear that and immediately tasted the cake. It was delicious! He thanked Jane and they both shared the cake and laughed together. 

John and Jane hugged each other and promised to always listen to each other even when things got tough.

Once upon a time there was a happy boy. He loved to explore the world around him. One day he was looking around his backyard and saw a frog. He wanted to take a closer look. So, he bent down to examine it. 

The frog suddenly began to sing a song. The boy was amazed by the sound and listened very carefully. The song was slow and sweet. He asked the frog, "What is that song?" 

The frog answered, "It is a song of friendship. It is a sweet reminder that friends can be found in the most unexpected places." 

The boy smiled and thanked the frog. From then on, he always examined the world around him in hopes of finding more new friends. The end.

Once there were two friends, Max and Bob. They liked to play together every day. One day, they were celebrating. They were celebrating that it was Bob's birthday. 

Max had brought lots of presents for Bob. One of the presents was an octopus. It was a very special octopus! Max was so excited to give it to Bob.

Max said to Bob, "I got you a very special octopus for your birthday. Look at it! Do you like it?" 
Bob replied, "I love it! It's so cool!"

But when Bob started to play with the octopus, he became very selfish. He didn't want Max to play with it.

Max looked sad and asked, "Why can't I play with the octopus, too?"

Bob smiled and said, "You can, Max. Of course you can, it's just for celebrating my birthday. We will share the octopus together. Let's have some fun!"

And that is how Max and Bob celebrated Bob's birthday with the special octopus. They had so much fun together!

Molly was very excited, as she was ready to explore the maze. She was with her parents, holding their hands and wondering what secrets the maze held. Molly's parents had been talking about mazes for days and Molly was eager to see one in real life.

Molly went further and further into the maze, taking each turn and discovering more and more twists and turns. Each corner was an adventure. Eventually, after a few turns, Molly became tired and a bit scared - she had been in the maze for what seemed like forever.

Molly's dad saw the tired look on her face and said, "Don't worry Molly, we'll surrender and go home."

Molly was relieved. She grabbed her parent's hands and they left the maze. Molly felt sure that one day she'd be brave enough to explore a maze again. 

As they left, Molly took one last look back. She felt excited to explore the maze one day and find out where each turn would lead her.

Once there were two friends named Jake and Sophie. They were both very strong, but one day Jake ran into trouble. He was sad, so Sophie said â€œLet me help.â€

They separated and Sophie looked for a way to make Jake happy. She gathered many things together then made a plan to surprise Jake.

When Sophie found him, she raced up and called â€œLook what I brought!â€ Jake was so happy that he hugged her tightly. 

From then on, Sophie and Jake were the best of friends. They helped each other out and never let trouble separate them.

Once upon a time there was a boy. He was very lonely and felt like he had no one else in the world. One day, he decided to go for a walk in the forest.

As he walked, he heard a noise. He thought it was strange and cautiously walked towards the sound. Then he saw a big, furry animal.

"Hello!" said the animal. "My name is Puppy and I am very hungry. Can you help me find something to eat?"

The boy felt a little scared, but he knew Puppy was just looking for a meal. He smiled and said, "Yes, I can get you something to eat."

The boy and Puppy went to a nearby house. The boy knocked on the door and asked the lady if she had anything for them to eat.

The lady was kind and gave them both a delicious meal. Puppy ate every bite and thanked the boy for helping him find it. The boy thanked the lady for the meal. 

They both went back to the forest and the boy said goodbye to Puppy. He couldn't believe how kind the lady was and how tasty the meal was. He smiled and waved goodbye to Puppy as he walked away.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat. The cat was so fat that he could barely move. One day, the cat decided to go for a walk with his friend, the dog.

The dog said, "Let's ride our bikes!" The cat replied, "That sounds like fun!"

They ran to the garage and got their bikes. The cat sat down on his bike and started to pedal. He felt so fast, like he was flying!

The dog laughed and said, "Your bike is too fat for you, cat!" The cat just kept pedaling.

After a while, the cat and the dog stopped to rest. They had a lot of fun riding their bikes and decided to go again the next day!

Once upon a time, there was a big, fancy house. It had a big, fancy window and a big, fancy door. 

One day, Johnny and his mommy were outside the house, admiring the window. Johnny's mommy said, "Johnny, how do you think we could reach the window?"

Johnny noticed a ladder, standing against the house. He pointed at it and said, "Look mommy, there's a ladder!" 

So Johnny's mommy got the ladder and Johnny helped her to stand it up against the house. Then, Johnny climbed the ladder all the way to the window. 

From the top of the ladder, Johnny could wave to all the people inside the house. Everyone in the house was so excited, especially when Johnny shouted out, "I can see you!" 

Johnny and his mommy had a lot of fun. The fancy window stood tall, and their smiles were even higher.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lola. She was very brave and liked to try new things.

One day, Lola's mom gave her an onion. Lola was uncomfortable because she had never tried an onion before.

Mom smiled and said "Lola, why don't you try it! You'll feel better when you taste how good it is."

Lola took a deep breath and bit the onion. At first she felt uncomfortable and wanted to stop, but she kept trying. With each bite she felt better and better.

Finally, after eating the entire onion, she felt much better. She was surprised and made a huge smile.

"Mom, I like onions now!" she said. "It was hard at first, but it was worth it so I could improve!"

Mom nodded and said "I'm very proud of you, Lola. You tried something new, and you got better at it!"

One day, Sally was running in the park with her hoop. Suddenly, she saw a cute little squirrel with a long tail. Sally was so excited that she wanted to play with it.

She ran closer and the squirrel stopped. Sally smiled and said, "Hi Squirrel! Can I play with you?" 

The squirrel just looked at her and didn't answer. Then another squirrel came closer, hopped around the first one and then ran away. Sally smiled again and said, "Please, can I play with you?" 

The first squirrel looked at Sally and then hopped to the hoop. Sally was so happy that she clapped her hands and started to play with the squirrel. They played tag with the hoop, hopping around in circles and having lots of fun. 

In the end, they both stopped. Sally thanked the squirrel and ran off home. She had lots of fun playing with her new friend in the park.

Once upon a time there was a car named Gavin. He was orange and had white spots. Gavin was always in a hurry. He was always speeding down the road. 

One day, Gavin was driving along when he saw a line. It was a long, thin line right in the middle of the road. The line looked like it went on forever. Gavin was curious. He wanted to get to the other side, so he went faster and faster. 

Gavin felt like he was going so fast, but the line still didn't end. Suddenly, he heard a voice. 

"Whoa, Gavin! Slow down!" yelled the voice. It was a woman standing beside the line.

Gavin stopped and the woman said, "You need to follow the regular speed here, Gavin. This line never ends, so you can't speed over it."

Gavin thanked the woman and drove slowly from then on. He learned that day that things sometimes take longer if you speed.

Once upon a time there was a unique elephant called Ella. Ella was a special elephant because she had the loudest trumpet and the longest trunk!

One day, Ella found herself in trouble. She had been walking with her friends around the jungle when she slipped into a deep hole. Ella was very scared and called out for help.

Just then, she heard a voice. There was a brave elephant called Bruce who was nearby. Bruce was so kind that he had come to rescue Ella.

Bruce: "Don't worry Ella, I'm here to help!"

Ella was so relieved to hear Bruce's voice. He carefully pulled her out of the deep hole and Ella thanked him for rescuing her. From then on, Ella and Bruce were best friends and always looked out for each other.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sammy. She loved to go to the park and play. One day, when Sammy was at the park, she saw a beautiful pastry sitting on a park bench. It was round and smelled so good! Sammy looked around, but there was no one in sight. She cautiously walked over to the pastry and picked it up.

â€œThis looks good!", Sammy said.

Just then a friendly voice called out, â€œThat pastry was for me!â€

Startled, Sammy looked around and saw a man sitting on the bench. 

â€œBut itâ€™s a very big pastry,â€ Sammy said. 

The man smiled and said, â€œLetâ€™s share it. That way we can both have some.â€

So, Sammy and the man happily shared the pastry. It was as sweet as can be! When they were done eating, Sammy thanked the man and waved goodbye as she skipped off to play in the park.

Once upon a time there was a boat. It was a beautiful boat and it was ready to sail! The boat had bright blue and yellow sails.

The boat was full of people. One of them was a woman with a big smile. She said to her friends, "Let's go! We are going to make a big loop!"

They all cheered with excitement. They started to sail the boat over the blue sea. The wind blew and the boat sped up.

Suddenly, something strange happened. One of the passengers got deaf. Everybody was scared.

But the woman on the boat said, "Don't worry. I will make a special loop that will make him better!"

And so, she sailed the boat around and around in a huge loop. After a few minutes, the man was better and could hear again.

They continued their journey and sailed off into the sunset.

Once upon a time there was a lazy pipe. He didn't like to move very much and so spent most of his days sleeping.

One day, he was awoken by a voice. It was a number! The number said, "Hey pipe! Wake up! Let's go exploring!". The pipe sighed and replied, "No thanks. I'm too lazy to move." 

But the number was persistent. He said, "Come on, pipe! Moving will make you feel better, I promise!"

The pipe thought about it for a minute, and then decided to give it a try. So, he moved his long body around and even danced a bit. He was surprised to find that he actually enjoyed it!

So, from then on the lazy pipe and the number went on many fun adventures. No matter what, the pipe was always happy to go exploring with his friend.

"Mommy, can I dress up?" asked the little girl.

"Of course," her mom said.

The girl went to her room and got out her favorite dress. She put it on and twirled around in it.

She then asked, "Mommy, can I use your microphone?"

"That's a good idea," mom said.

The girl grabbed the microphone and pretended to be a singer. She sang her favorite song at the top of her lungs.

Mom said, "You are so interesting and creative. I'm so proud of you!"

The girl smiled and thanked mom. She then put the microphone away, and the two hugged.

Once upon a time there was a girl who loved to solve puzzles. On this special day, she had three puzzles that she wanted to complete.

The first puzzle was made of plastic and it was hard to solve. The girl tried to think of the right way to put it together and after a few tries, she finally did it!

The second puzzle was also plastic and it was very hard. The girl was determined to figure it out and so she kept on looking and thinking hard until she finally solved it.

The last puzzle was made of hard plastic and it looked like it would be tricky to solve. But the girl never gave up and after a few attempts, she managed to put it together.

Suddenly, a voice said, "You did it! You solved all three puzzles!" The girl looked around and saw a big doggy smile at her. She smiled back and said, "I did it all by myself!"

Once upon a time, there was a small fish called Fin. Fin loved to swim around in the calm river. One day, Fin noticed a gentle wave rise up in the distance and he swam towards it. 

As he got closer, he saw something strange. A small wood boat was being carried by the wave, with a smiling old man inside. When Fin was close enough, the old man called out, "Hello there Fin! You look so strong and brave, could you help me get to the other side of the river?" 

Fin was so excited. He wanted to help the old man, so he nodded his head. Then he swam alongside the boat, pushing it with all the strength he had.

The old man thanked him, patting Fin's head with a gentle hand. Then, with Fin's help, the boat rose up to the other side of the river. The old man waved goodbye, and Fin waved back, before swimming off to explore the other side of the river.

Jack went to the beach with his mom. He couldn't wait to explore! His mom said, "Let's test the water. Is it too cold?" Jack was excited and waded in the water. It was just the right temperature!

Soon, Jack saw something shiny in the sand. He ran over to pick it up. It was a big, fancy oyster! "Wow Mom, look at this oyster! Can I keep it?" His mom smiled and said yes. 

Jack held the oyster in his hands and asked, "Can I open it?" His mom nodded. She said, "It's okay to try, but be careful!" Jack carefully pried the oyster open and found a shining pearl inside. He exclaimed, "Mom, look! I found a pearl in this fancy oyster!" His Mom smiled, "Wow, that was a fun test!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, mom said, "Amy, let's make some cookies!" Amy was very excited and said, "Yes, mom!"

First, they had to mix the dough. Amy poured some flour, sugar, and eggs into a big bowl. Then, she mixed it all together with her hands. It was a harmless and fun thing to do. The dough felt soft and squishy.

When the dough was ready, Amy and her mom rolled it out on the table. They used cookie cutters to make fun shapes like stars, hearts, and circles. Then, they put the cookies in the oven to bake. Soon, the whole house smelled like yummy cookies. Amy and her mom enjoyed eating the delicious cookies they made together.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily wanted to go to the park. She put on her shoes and asked her mom, "Can I go to the park, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, but be careful, and don't go too far."

At the park, Lily saw a fragile butterfly. She wanted to play with it. She tried to turn around to catch it, but she was not fast enough. The butterfly flew away. Lily was sad and wanted to find the butterfly again.

Lily looked everywhere in the park for the butterfly. She saw a big tree and thought the butterfly might be there. As she went to the tree, she found a boy named Tim. Tim was also looking for the butterfly. They both wanted the butterfly, but there was only one. They decided to take turns to catch it. Lily tried first, but she could not catch it. Then Tim tried, and he caught the butterfly. He shared it with Lily, and they both were happy. They played together at the park until it was time to go home.

One day, Tom and Sue were playing with paper. They wanted to cut the paper, but they only had one pair of scissors. Tom said, "Let's share the scissors, Sue!"

Sue said, "Okay, Tom! I will cut first." Sue cut the paper. It was tough to cut, but she did it. Then, she gave the scissors to Tom. Tom cut the paper too. It was tough for him as well, but he was happy to do it.

After they both cut the paper, they made a big mess. Tom and Sue looked at each other and laughed. They had fun sharing the scissors and cutting the tough paper. Then, they cleaned up the mess together.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the park with her mom. They saw a large tree with many colorful balloons tied to it. Lily was very excited and asked her mom, "What's going on, mommy?"

Her mom replied, "It looks like someone is having a party to celebrate something special!"

While they were walking, Lily saw a stranger with a big smile on his face. He was giving out cupcakes to everyone. Lily wanted a cupcake too, but she remembered her mom's words about not talking to strangers.

Lily looked at her mom and asked, "Can I have a cupcake, mommy?" Her mom said, "Let me ask the man for you." Her mom talked to the stranger and got a cupcake for Lily.

They both enjoyed the cupcake and joined the celebration. Lily was happy to be a part of the fun day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a playful little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in nature. She would run, jump, and laugh with her friends.

One sunny day, Lily met a small bird. The bird said, "Tweet, tweet! I don't understand where my family is." Lily wanted to help the bird find its family. They looked under rocks, on top of trees, and near the river.

Finally, they found the bird's family in a big tree. The bird was so happy and said, "Thank you, Lily! You are a good friend." Lily smiled and said, "You're welcome! I'm glad I could help." Then, they all played together in the beautiful nature.

One day, a happy cat named Tom found a radio. He lay down next to it and listened to fun songs. He liked the music and started to dance. Tom was so happy that he wanted to show his friend, Sam the dog.

Tom went to Sam's house and said, "Sam, come see what I found! It plays fun songs!" Sam came with Tom to see the radio. They both lay down and listened to the music. They were very happy and danced together.

But then, the radio stopped playing music. Tom and Sam were sad. They tried to make it work, but they could not. They lay down next to the radio, not happy anymore. The fun songs were gone, and they missed them.

Once upon a time, there was a gifted little girl. She could do many things that other kids could not do. She had a pretty white dress that she loved to wear.

One day, the little girl went to the park. She played with her friends and had lots of fun. But she fell down and got her pretty white dress dirty. The little girl started to weep. She was very sad.

A kind lady saw the girl weeping and asked, "Why are you weeping, dear?" The little girl said, "My pretty white dress is dirty now." The kind lady smiled and said, "Don't worry, I can help you!" She cleaned the dress and made it white again. The little girl was happy and thanked the kind lady. They played together in the park and became good friends.

One day, a cool cat named Tom went for a walk. He saw a big green thing with spikes. It was a cactus! Tom thought it was very cool. He wanted to play with it, but he did not want to get hurt by the spikes. So, he thought of a plan.

Tom found a long stick. He thought he could use the stick to play with the cactus. But then, he saw his friend, the dog named Max. Max wanted to play with Tom. Tom wanted to play with Max too, but he wanted to play with the cactus first. So, Tom told Max to wait. He said, "Max, I have to delay our play."

Tom used the stick to touch the cactus. It was fun! He did not get hurt. Then, he heard Max bark. Max was sad because he was waiting for a long time. Tom knew it was time to play with Max. He left the cactus and went to play with Max. They had a lot of fun together. Tom was happy he could play with the cactus and Max too.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a helpful man named Tom. Tom liked to create things with his hands. One day, he decided to make a big chest to store toys for the children in the village.

Tom worked hard to make the chest. He used wood, nails, and paint. When he was done, the chest was very big and colorful. He put the chest in the middle of the village and filled it with toys.

One day, a little girl named Lily saw the chest and said, "Wow! Look at all the toys!" Tom smiled and said, "Take one, and share with your friends." Lily took a toy and shared it with her friends. They all played together and had a lot of fun.

Soon, all the children in the village learned to share the toys from the chest. They learned that sharing was good and made everyone happy. The helpful man, Tom, was happy to see the children playing together.

The moral of the story is that sharing is a good thing, and being helpful can make everyone happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily was very impatient. She wanted to help her mom cook dinner. Her mom said, "Okay, Lily, you can help me cut the vegetables."

Lily was so happy. She took a bowl and put the vegetables in it. Then, she started to cut them with her safe little knife. She cut a carrot, a potato, and a tomato. She put them all in the bowl.

Her mom looked at the bowl and said, "Good job, Lily! Now we can cook the vegetables for dinner." Lily smiled and felt proud. She learned that even though she was impatient, she could still help her mom and do a good job.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little car named Bumpy. Bumpy loved to drive fast and far. One day, Bumpy saw his friend, a colorful crayon named Colorful.

"Hi Colorful!" said Bumpy. "Do you want to come with me for a fun drive?"

Colorful smiled and said, "Yes, Bumpy! I love to go on drives with you!"

So, Bumpy and Colorful went for a drive. They went up and down hills, and all around the town. Bumpy went fast, and Colorful laughed and laughed.

As they drove, Colorful used his colors to make the world pretty. He made the grass green, the sky blue, and the flowers all kinds of colors.

At the end of the day, Bumpy and Colorful were very happy. They had a great day driving and making the world pretty. And from that day on, they were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived an old man with a cane. He had a big cat named Fluffy. Fluffy was not a good cat. He did terrible things. He broke cups and knocked over plants.

One day, Fluffy and a little bird had a quarrel. "You are a bad cat!" said the little bird. "No, I am not!" said Fluffy. They were very loud.

The old man heard the quarrel and came outside. He saw the mess Fluffy made. "Fluffy, you must be good," said the old man. Fluffy felt sad and said, "I will be good." From that day on, Fluffy was a good cat and never had a quarrel again.

Once upon a time, there was a smelly dog named Spot. Spot loved to play in the mud and roll around in the dirt. He was a very happy dog, but sometimes he would get very dirty.

One day, Spot was playing outside and found a big pile of mud. He jumped in the mud and rolled around, getting very smelly. Then, Spot went back to the house to show his family how much fun he had. But when he got home, his family did not like the smell.

Spot's family told him that he needed to take a bath. Spot did not like baths, but he knew he had to get clean. He felt regret for getting so smelly. Spot took a bath and was clean again. From that day on, Spot tried to stay clean and not get too smelly.

One day, a girl named Lily found a tray full of yummy cookies. She wanted to eat them all, but she knew she should share with her friend, Tom. So, she split the cookies into two piles. One pile for her and one pile for Tom.

"Tom, I have yummy cookies!" Lily said. "I split them for us to share."

But Tom was not happy. He wanted more cookies. "No, I want more!" he said. This made Lily sad. She thought she had split the cookies fairly.

Lily and Tom talked about the cookies. They decided to ask their mom to help them split the cookies again. Mom made sure both Lily and Tom got the same amount of yummy cookies. Now, they were both happy and could enjoy their yummy cookies together.

One day, a boy named Tim found a hidden box under his bed. Inside the box, there was a game called chess. Tim did not know how to play chess. He asked his mom, "Mom, can you teach me how to play chess?"

His mom said, "Yes, I can teach you. First, I will show you the pieces and how they move." She took out the pieces and lead Tim through the game. They played chess together, and Tim started to learn.

Soon, Tim got better at chess. He played with his friends and even won a game. Tim was happy that he found the hidden chess game and that his mom lead him to learn it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to help his mom in the kitchen. One day, they decided to make muffins together. Tim was very excited to work with his mom.

As they mixed the batter, Mom said, "Tim, we need to add something sweet. If we don't, the muffins will taste bitter." Tim nodded and added some sweet stuff to the mix. They put the muffins in the oven and waited for them to bake.

When the muffins were ready, Tim and his mom took them out of the oven. They smelled so good! Tim took a big bite of a muffin and smiled. "Mom, these are the best muffins ever!" he said. Mom smiled too, happy that they had worked together to make the muffins taste just right.

One day, a little bird named Tim had a messy nest. His mom said, "Tim, you need to clean your nest and bathe." Tim did not want to clean his nest or bathe. He wanted to play with his friends.

Tim went to play with his friends, but they all had clean wings. His friend, Sue, said, "Tim, you should clean your wings. We can't play with you if you're messy." Tim felt sad and went back home.

Tim cleaned his nest and took a bath. His mom was happy, and Tim felt good. He went to play with his friends, and they all had fun. Tim learned that it is important to be clean and neat.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the gym with her mom. The gym was a big and tidy place where people went to play and have fun. Lily loved going to the gym because she could run, jump, and play with her friends.

While Lily was playing, she saw a big box in the corner of the gym. She was curious about what was inside the box. So, she went closer and decided to peek inside. When she peeked, she saw a big, bouncy ball! Lily was so happy and excited to find the ball.

Lily called her friend, Tom, and said, "Look, I found a big ball! Let's play with it!" Tom came over and they both played with the ball, bouncing it high into the air and laughing. They had so much fun at the gym that day.

One day, a boy named Tim and his dog, Spot, went for a walk in the big park. They saw a wide tree with many branches. Tim said, "Let's go climb that tree, Spot!" Spot wagged his tail and barked, "Yes, let's go!"

As they climbed the tree, they heard an alarm sound. "What's that?" asked Tim. "I don't know," barked Spot. They looked around and saw a little bird stuck in a hole. The bird was making the alarm sound because it needed help.

Tim and Spot went to the little bird. Tim said, "Don't worry, bird. We will help you!" They worked together to get the bird out of the hole. The bird was happy and thanked them. Tim and Spot felt good for helping a friend. They continued their fun day at the park, playing together under the wide tree.

One day, a little girl named Sue and her mom were talking. Sue said, "Mom, I want a holiday." Mom smiled and said, "We can plan a fun trip, but not too expensive."

They looked at a big book with pictures of places. Sue saw a picture of a beach. She said, "I want to go here!" Mom said, "That's a nice beach. Let's save money for our trip."

Sue helped Mom save money. She put coins in a jar. One day, the jar was full. Mom said, "We have enough money for our holiday!"

They went to the beach. Sue played in the sand and swam in the water. She was very happy. At the end of the day, Sue said, "Thank you, Mom, for our fun holiday!"

One day, a little turkey named Tim was very excited. He was going to play with his friends in the park. Tim ran to the park as fast as his little turkey legs could go.

When Tim got to the park, he saw a big dog. The dog was loud and scary. Tim started to tremble because he was scared of the big dog. He wanted to play with his friends, but the dog was in the way.

Tim's friend, a small bird named Bobby, saw that Tim was scared. Bobby said, "Don't worry, Tim. I will help you." Bobby flew over to the big dog and started to sing a pretty song. The big dog liked the song and followed Bobby away from the park.

Now Tim was not scared anymore. He stopped trembling and went to play with his friends. They all had a fun day at the park. Tim was very happy and thankful for his brave friend Bobby.

Once upon a time, there was a little ball named Billy. Billy loved to roll around the park. One day, he saw a big frame near the trees. It was a new thing for him, so he felt worried.

Billy called his friend, a small bird named Polly. "Polly, what is this big frame?" he asked. Polly flew closer and looked at the frame. "Don't be worried, Billy," said Polly. "It's just a frame to play with. You can roll through it."

Billy was excited to try it. He rolled through the frame and laughed. Polly cheered for him. They played together all day long. Billy was no longer worried about the frame, and he had lots of fun with his friend Polly.

One day, a little girl named Mia went for a walk. She saw a delicate butterfly sitting on a flower. Mia said, "Hello, butterfly! I am Mia. What is your name?" The butterfly did not say anything, but it danced in the air.

Mia wanted to introduce the butterfly to her friends. She took the butterfly to her friends, Tom and Lily. Mia said, "Tom, Lily, meet my new friend, the butterfly!" Tom and Lily said, "Hello, butterfly!"

Together, they decided to have a march around the garden. Mia, Tom, Lily, and the butterfly marched and danced in the sun. They had a fun day playing together.

Once upon a time, there was a rich man named Tom. Tom had a big house and many toys. One day, Tom saw a little bird in a small jail. The bird was sad and wanted to fly.

Tom said, "Little bird, I will help you." Tom went to the jail and used his hands to lift the door. The bird was free and happy. The bird said, "Thank you, Tom!"

From that day, Tom and the little bird were best friends. They played together every day. Tom learned that helping others made him happier than his big house and many toys.

One day, a boy named Tim went to a parade with his mom. They saw big balloons and people playing music. Tim loved the parade a lot.

Tim saw a man with a funny hat. The man said, "I feel stupid with this hat, but it's fun!" Tim laughed and said, "I love your hat!" The man smiled and gave Tim a high five.

At the end of the parade, Tim and his mom went home. They talked about the funny man with the stupid hat. Tim said, "I want to go to another parade!" His mom hugged him and said, "We will go again soon."

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a weak old man named Tom. Tom had a big iron, which he used to press his clothes. One day, he needed help with his iron because it was too heavy for him.

Tom went to his friend, Sam, and said, "Sam, please help me with my iron. I am too weak to use it." Sam agreed and said, "Sure, Tom. I will help you." So, Sam went to Tom's house and helped him press his clothes with the iron.

After they were done, Tom thanked Sam and said, "Thank you, Sam. You are a good friend." Sam smiled and said, "You're welcome, Tom. I am always here to help you." And from that day on, they became the best of friends and always helped each other when they needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a small cat named Kitty. Kitty liked to play with her friends, but sometimes she was not nice. One day, Kitty took her friend's toy without asking.

Kitty's friend, Doggy, said, "Kitty, that's my toy! Please give it back!" But Kitty didn't want to give it back. She ran away with the toy and hid it under a tree.

Soon, the other animals found out what Kitty did. They were very angry. They said, "Kitty, you must become good, or you will go to jail." But Kitty didn't listen to them.

One day, the animals caught Kitty taking another toy. They said, "Now you must go to jail." They put Kitty in a small jail made of sticks.

Kitty was sad, and she did not like the bad ending. She wished she had been good and listened to her friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to watch his favorite show on the television. Tim was very calm as he sat on the floor in front of the television. He waited for his show to start.

His mom walked into the room and said, "Tim, please stand up and turn on the television." Tim stood up and pushed the button on the television. The screen lit up, and his show began to play.

As Tim watched his show, a friendly dog named Spot came into the room. Spot sat down next to Tim and watched the television too. They both enjoyed the show and were very calm and happy.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim went to school. His teacher, Miss Kate, was very nice. Tim had many friends who were pupils too. They played and learned together. One day, Tim saw a big, shiny toy car in a shop. It was very expensive, but he wanted it so much.

Tim asked his mom, "Can I have the expensive toy car, please?" His mom said, "No, it is too much money. We cannot buy it." Tim was sad, but he had an idea. He thought he could take the toy car without his mom knowing.

The next day, Tim went to the shop and took the toy car. He hid it in his bag and went to school. When he got to school, he showed his friends the toy car. They all wanted to play with it. Tim let them play with the car, but he didn't tell them he took it from the shop.

Miss Kate saw the pupils playing with the expensive toy car. She knew it was not Tim's car. She asked Tim, "Where did you get this car?" Tim didn't want to tell the truth. He lied and said, "My mom bought it for me." Miss Kate knew Tim was not telling the truth. She called his mom and found out he took the car from the shop.

Tim got in big trouble. His mom was very sad and angry. She made Tim return the toy car to the shop and say sorry. Tim learned that taking things without asking is wrong. He felt bad and promised never to do it again. But because he lied, his friends and Miss Kate did not trust him anymore. Tim was very sad and lonely.

One day, a cute little girl named Lily went to her garden. She had a small bag of beans. She wanted to grow big bean plants. Lily dug a hole in the ground and put a bean in it. She covered the bean with dirt and gave it some water. "Grow big and strong, little bean," she said.

The next day, Lily saw a small bird in her garden. The bird looked at the place where Lily put the bean. "Are you looking for my bean?" Lily asked the bird. The bird nodded its head. Lily thought the bird was hungry, so she gave it some seeds to eat. "You can visit my bean, but don't eat it, okay?" The bird nodded again and flew away.

Days went by, and Lily took care of her bean every day. The bird came back to visit, too. One day, the bean started to grow into a big, strong plant. Lily was so happy! The bird came back and saw the big bean plant. It nodded its head and flew away. Lily knew that the bird was happy for her and her big bean plant.

Once upon a time, there was a big, bossy cat named Tom. Tom liked to tell everyone what to do. He lived in a small house with his friend, a little mouse named Tim.

One day, Tom saw Tim near the stove. Tom was scared that Tim might get hurt. So, he yelled, "Tim, stay away from the stove!" Tim jumped and ran away from the stove quickly.

From that day on, Tim knew that Tom was only bossy because he cared. They played together and had lots of fun. And Tim never went near the stove again.

One day, a big rain came. It made the ground very wet. A little boy named Tim went outside to play. He saw a small bird who was sad.

"Why are you sad?" Tim asked the bird.

"My nest is wet, and I can't keep my eggs warm," the bird said.

Tim wanted to help the bird. He found a dry spot under a big tree. He helped the bird move her nest there. The bird was happy.

"Thank you, Tim," said the bird. "Now I can keep my eggs warm."

From that day on, Tim and the bird were good friends. They played together every day, even when the ground was wet.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a fearful tiger. The tiger was scared of everything. He was scared of the wind, the rain, and even the little bugs.

One day, the fearful tiger found a small, lost kitten. The kitten was all alone, and it was sad. The tiger wanted to help the kitten, so he decided to carry it on his back. Together, they walked through the forest, looking for the kitten's home.

As they walked, the fearful tiger started to feel brave. He was not scared of the wind or the rain anymore. The little kitten made the tiger feel strong. Finally, they found the kitten's home, and the tiger was very happy. From that day on, the tiger was not fearful anymore. He had a new friend, and they lived happily in the big forest.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the kitchen. She wanted to make lemon juice. She saw a big bowl on the table. Lily picked up a lemon and began to squeeze it into the bowl. The juice went into the bowl, and Lily was happy.

Just then, Lily's dog, Max, came into the kitchen. He barked loud, "Woof! Woof!" Lily said, "Max, you are so loud! I am making lemon juice. Do you want some?" Max wagged his tail and barked again, "Woof! Woof!"

Lily poured some lemon juice into a small bowl for Max. He lapped it up and made a funny face. "It's sour, isn't it, Max?" Lily giggled. Max barked softly, "Woof!" They both laughed and enjoyed the lemon juice together.

One day, a little girl named Lucy found a jar of jam. It was her favorite, red and sweet. She wanted to eat it all. But the jar was tough to open. She tried and tried, but it just would not open.

Lucy asked her big brother Tom for help. "Tom, can you open this tough jar for me?" Tom was strong and opened the jar easily. But as he opened it, he accidentally cut his finger on the jar's lid. It hurt a lot.

Lucy felt bad and wanted to help Tom. She knew that hugs could heal. So, she hugged Tom tight and said, "I'm sorry, Tom. I hope your finger heals fast." Tom smiled and thanked Lucy for her hug. They both enjoyed the sweet jam together, and soon, Tom's finger healed.

One day, a boy went to visit a king. The king was very big and wore a gold hat. The king was troubled because he lost his favorite toy.

The boy said, "King, don't be sad. I will help you find your toy." They looked in the big room and the small room. They looked under the bed and in the toy box.

At last, they found the toy behind a big chair. The king was very happy. He said, "Thank you, boy! You are a good friend." And they played with the toy together.

One day, a girl named Sue had a basket. Sue loved her basket because it was very good at holding things. She could put her toys, food, and other stuff in it. Sue thought her basket was reliable.

Sue wanted to show her friend, Tom, her basket. She went outside and saw Tom. "Look at my basket!" Sue said to Tom. Tom looked at the basket and thought it was nice. But Tom wanted to see if it was strong. He took the basket and started to run with it.

Sue did not want Tom to run with her basket. She was scared that he would break it. Sue ran after Tom and said, "Stop! Please give me my basket back!" Tom stopped running and looked at Sue. He saw that she was upset.

Tom said sorry to Sue and gave her back the basket. Sue was happy to have her basket back. They both learned that it is important to be careful with other people's things. And Sue learned that her basket was strong and reliable, even when Tom ran with it.

One day, a little red car named Zoomy loved to zoom around his town. He liked to make a loud whistle sound as he went fast. The sun was warm and bright today, so Zoomy went out to play.

Zoomy saw his friend, a big blue car named Biggy. Biggy said, "Zoomy, can I join you to play?" Zoomy said, "Yes, but we must race to see who is the fastest!" Biggy agreed, and they started to race. Zoomy went zoom and made a loud whistle sound, but Biggy was going faster.

Zoomy was sad because he wanted to be the fastest. He told Biggy, "I don't want to play anymore." Biggy felt bad and said, "I'm sorry, Zoomy. Let's play another game where we can both have fun!" So, Zoomy and Biggy played a new game, and they both had a great time in the warm sun.

One day, a little girl named Mia wanted to draw a picture. She went to her room to unpack her box of crayons. Mia saw that her favorite crayon, the red one, was dry and broken. She felt sad and didn't know what to do.

Mia went to her mom and said, "Mom, my red crayon is dry and broken. I can't draw my picture now." Her mom looked at the dry crayon and thought for a moment.

Her mom said, "Let's go to the store and buy a new box of crayons. Then you can draw your picture with a new red crayon." Mia felt happy and excited to get new crayons.

At the store, Mia picked out a big box of crayons with many colors. When they got home, Mia unpacked her new crayons and started to draw her picture. She was very happy that she could draw with her new red crayon.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a popular boy in his school. He had many friends who liked to play with him. Tim was nice and never teased anyone.

One Tuesday, Tim and his friends were playing in the park. They saw a new boy sitting alone. Tim went to the new boy and said, "Hi, I'm Tim. Do you want to play with us?" The new boy smiled and said, "Yes, thank you!"

As they played, one of Tim's friends started to tease the new boy. Tim said, "Stop teasing him. We should be nice to our new friend." Tim's friend said sorry, and they all played happily together. The new boy was happy to have nice friends like Tim, and they all had a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a clean dog named True. True loved to play outside with his best friend, a little boy named Sam. They would run and jump and have lots of fun together.

One day, True and Sam went to play near a big tree. But True did not see a big rock and he fell down. Poor True started to suffer because his leg hurt a lot. Sam was sad to see his best friend in pain.

Sam knew he had to help True. He took True to his mom, who put a soft bandage on True's leg. With lots of love and care, True started to feel better. Soon, True and Sam were back to having fun together, and they were more careful near the big tree.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who loved to hop. One day, he hopped to a big tree where all the animals were meeting. They were meeting to see who could hop the farthest.

The bunny was worried because he had never hopped in front of so many animals before. He saw a wise old owl sitting on a branch. The owl was the judge of the hopping game. The bunny asked the owl, "Can I hop too?"

The owl said, "Yes, little bunny, you can hop too." So, the bunny hopped as far as he could. All the animals clapped and cheered. The wise old owl, the judge, said, "You did a great job, little bunny! You hopped very far."

The bunny was very happy and not worried anymore. He knew that he could hop far and make new friends. From that day on, the bunny hopped and played with all the animals under the big tree. They all had lots of fun together.

Once upon a time, in an ordinary little town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim was very hungry. His stomach made loud noises. He wanted to eat something yummy.

Tim saw a big apple tree. He asked his friend, Sam, "Can you please help me get an apple?" Sam agreed and helped Tim climb the tree. They both picked apples and ate them. But the apples were not ordinary apples.

Soon, Tim and Sam felt sick. Their stomachs hurt a lot. They cried out, "Oh no! What did we eat?" They did not know that the apples were bad apples.

In the end, Tim and Sam were still sick. They learned a lesson to not eat apples from that tree again. Their ordinary day turned into a very bad day.

Once upon a time, there was a yellow house. In the house, there was a girl named Sally. Sally loved to paint. She had a lot of fun making pretty pictures.

One day, Sally's friend Timmy came over to play. They decided to paint together. Timmy said, "Sally, let's paint a big, yellow sun!" Sally agreed, and they started to paint the sun on a big piece of paper.

While they were painting, the telephone rang. Sally picked it up and said, "Hello?" It was her grandma on the other side. Grandma said, "Hi Sally! I miss you. Can I come visit you today?" Sally was very happy and said, "Yes, Grandma! Please come. We are painting a big, yellow sun!"

Grandma came over, and they all painted together. They had a great time, and the big, yellow sun was very pretty. At the end of the day, they hung the painting on the wall, and it made everyone smile.

One day, a boy named Tim found a small, rough metal car. He loved to play with cars, so he was very happy. He showed it to his mom and said, "Look, Mom! I found a car!"

His mom looked at the car and said, "That's a nice car, Tim. You can drive it around the house."

Tim drove the car around the living room, making car noises. He drove it on the rug, under the table, and near the big chair. The car went fast and Tim laughed.

Later, Tim's friend, Lily, came over to play. Tim showed her the rough metal car. They both drove it around the house, having lots of fun. They played together until it was time for Lily to go home.

One day, a bird wanted to fly high in the sky. The bird was very serious about flying. He flapped his wings and flew up, up, up!

As the bird flew, he saw a point far away. He wanted to go to the point. He thought, "I can fly there!" So, he flew and flew until he got close to the point.

When he got to the point, he saw a little bug. The bug said, "Hello, bird! Did you fly here?" The bird said, "Yes, I did! I flew very high to get here." The bug and the bird became friends, and they played together at the point.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sally. She liked to play with her doll named Lucy. One day, Sally met a boy named Tom. Tom had a toy car. They played together and had fun.

Sally said to Tom, "I want to marry you." Tom said, "OK, let's marry." They played a game where they pretended to be married. They had a big party with their toys.

But then, a bad dog came. The dog took Lucy and the toy car. Sally and Tom said, "No, bad dog!" They chased the dog and got their toys back. They were happy and played together again.

One day, a little girl named Lily went outside to play. The weather was sunny and warm. She saw her friend, Tim, sitting on the grass. He looked sad and sorry.

Lily sat down next to Tim and asked, "Why are you sad?" Tim whispered, "I lost my toy car." Lily wanted to help Tim feel better, so she said, "Let's look for it together!"

They looked under the trees, behind the bushes, and in the sandbox. Finally, they found the toy car hiding in the tall grass. Tim was so happy, he hugged Lily and said, "Thank you for helping me!" From that day on, Lily and Tim were the best of friends.

One day, a white owl lived in a big tree. The white owl loved to fly at night and look for food. The white owl had a friend, a small brown mouse. They liked to play together in the forest.

One day, the white owl saw a big, red apple on the ground. The white owl wanted to share the apple with the small brown mouse. But the apple was not good. It was old and it had started to rot. The white owl did not know that the apple was bad.

The white owl and the small brown mouse ate the bad apple. Soon, they both felt sick. They were very sad because they could not play together in the forest anymore. The white owl and the small brown mouse learned that they should not eat food that is old and rotten.

Once upon a time, there was a dry tree. An owl lived in the tree. The owl had a friend, a little mouse. The mouse lived in a hole near the tree. One day, the owl and the mouse wanted to play a game.

The owl said, "Let's measure our tails!" The mouse thought it was a fun game. They both took turns to measure their tails. The mouse's tail was long, but the owl's tail was short.

The owl said, "You win, little mouse!" The mouse was very happy. They both laughed and played more games. The owl and the mouse were best friends and always had fun together.
